prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray tan (airbrush/sunless) or a UV tanning salon (tanning beds)? And which Charlotte neighborhood or zip code are you near?

If you’re not sure yet, here’s how I can help and some quick guidance so you find the “best” place for your needs:

What I can do for you
- If you tell me spray vs. UV and roughly where you are (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, NoDa, etc.), I’ll give tailored salon recommendations and what to ask when you call.
- Or I can give a short checklist and search phrases so you can quickly find top-rated salons near you.

How to pick the best tanning salon
- Define the service: spray tans are safest and give immediate color without UV risk; salons that offer high-quality spray tans use well-known solutions (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic) and have certified techs.
- Ratings & recent reviews: look for Google/Yelp 4.5+ with many recent reviews (past 6–12 months).
- Before & after photos: check the salon’s Instagram/Facebook for real client photos.
- Cleanliness & equipment: for UV beds, inspect bed condition and ask about bulb replacement schedule and sanitation. For spray, ask about pre-tan prep, gowns, and drying area.
- Technician experience & training: ask whether techs are certified and how long they’ve been doing spray tans.
- Pricing & packages: compare single-session price and package/membership savings; confirm any cancellation/no-show fees.
- Solution options & customization: good places offer multiple shades/formulas and adjust based on skin tone, and provide aftercare instructions.
- Safety: if considering UV beds, remember major medical organizations warn against tanning beds because of skin cancer risk. Spray tan or self-tanner is safer.

Sample search phrases to use
- “best spray tan Charlotte NC”
- “airbrush spray tan near me Charlotte”
- “best tanning salon Charlotte NC reviews”
- “versaspa Charlotte spray tan”

If you tell me spray vs. UV and which area of Charlotte you’re in, I’ll recommend 3–5 salons to consider and the exact questions to ask them. Which do you prefer?
